messages:
maria_pm: FYI AcmeHealth just asked for a tightened Optimize toolkit MVP: batching heuristics + cache prescriptive rules + a simple quantization fallback. They want a pilot in 6 weeks. thoughts?
aj_eng: 6 weeks is aggressive. which of the three is must-have for them?
sarah_cs: Acme prioritized batching + cache. quantization is nice-to-have; they'd accept docs + manual rollback instead of an auto-switch.
leo_ml: for quant we can recommend int8 profiles and provide a documented fallback to fp16. must validate quality via eval hooks before any auto-swap.
emily_se: customers expect clear runbooks and a small set of signals that trigger rollback. can we define eval-triggered alert templates now?
tom_product: suggested MVP scope:
- adaptive batching presets (mobile-short, server-long)
- cache policy templates (prefix cache + TTL guidance)
- quantization fallback documented, auto-swap deferred to post-pilot
aj_eng: need SLO gates. propose: if batching causes >10% p95 regression vs baseline, we disable on that route.
leo_ml: eval alert example (simple rule you can share):
EVAL_ALERT name=token-concordance-drop; trigger_if concordance_delta <= -5% over N=500; action notify #product + rollback-to-baseline
sarah_cs: perfect. customer-facing acceptance bullets to share in pilot agreement?
maria_pm: draft acceptance criteria:
- Pilot: 3 customers including AcmeHealth
- Batching: <=10% p95 latency regression on targeted routes; cost savings >=15% on batched traffic
- Cache: prefix hit-rate >=20% within 2 weeks
- Quant fallback: documented steps; no silent quality regressions (eval alerts in place)
- Eval alerts: thresholded rules + daily digest to ops
tom_product: rollout policy: canary 5% (24h), 25% (72h), full. auto-fallback if eval alert fires.
emily_se: docs need examples for mobile (short prompts) and server (long context) presets and an SDK snippet to toggle presets. I can draft.
aj_eng: runtime question: will we support mixed batching (short + long) in same pool? that affects kernel selection.
leo_ml: runtime can bin by max_seq; config surface: batching_bucket = {"short":32, "long":8} and route metadata to pick bin. expose via preset names.
emily_se: expose presets to customers? they like toggles.
aj_eng: we can expose `preset: mobile-short` and `preset: server-long` mapped internally to bins.
sarah_cs: legal: cache only for non-PII routes. add route-level consent and opt-out example.
maria_pm: add to acceptance: pilot must include route-level consent and sample opt-out code.
leo_ml: quick engineering acceptance test plan:
1) baseline measurement on commit X
2) enable batching presets, synthetic load 100k requests, measure p95 + cost/token
3) run eval set (2k prompts), compute concordance, verify no eval alert
4) enable cache, measure hit-rate and eviction behavior
5) test quant fallback by swapping int8 artifact and verify quality delta <=2% or trigger rollback
aj_eng: rough estimates: batching + cache core = 4w eng + 1w testing/docs; quant fallback + eval hooks = 2-3w. parallelize to hit ~6-8w.
tom_product: prioritization rule: if timeline slips, defer auto-quant swap and ship quant doc + manual rollback only. keep eval alerts in MVP.
emily_se: customer comms: prepare 1-pager, sample config, and SDK toggle snippet.
sarah_cs: I'll confirm AcmeHealth's flexibility on staged rollout and legal constraints.
maria_pm: action items:
- @aj_eng: create epic + estimate PRs (due EOD Fri)
- @leo_ml: author eval-alert templates (due Tue)
- @emily_se: draft customer 1-pager + SDK snippets (due Wed)
- @sarah_cs: confirm pilot customers & legal (due Thu)
- @tom_product: finalize rollout gating text (due Fri)
release-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-toolkit/pilot-config v0.1 -> staging at 2025-02-12T09:00:00Z :rocket:
maria_pm: thanks all. leaning to greenlight Tom's scope, with quant deferred-auto. update tickets and let's sync Wed 10am for pilot sign-off. :thumbsup:
